items.title: BlockStrap: Magento and Adobe Commerce RCE
items.summary: BlockStrap is a CVSS 10.0 Magento and Adobe Commerce flaw that gives unauthenticated attackers remote code execution through a template engine injection. Adobe fixed it in APSB26-153 but requires a manual patch, and new installations remain vulnerable.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This Adobe Security Bulletin addresses multiple vulnerabilities rated critical, high, and medium, including CVE-2026-103849, which could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, arbitrary file system write, and security feature bypass. Adobe recommends users update their installations to the newest version.

items.title: StyleSmuggler: Magento and Adobe Commerce 0-day RCE under active attack
items.summary: Sansec discovered StyleSmuggler, a Magento and Adobe Commerce zero-day vulnerability with a CVSS score of 10.0, allowing unauthenticated attackers remote code execution. Attacks started on September 4th, and Adobe published an emergency hotfix on September 7th.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This security update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, which could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Adobe recommends applying the hotfix for CVE-2026-75650 in addition to this bulletin.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Adobe Commerce allows unauthenticated remote code execution and privilege escalation
items.summary: This critical vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch a customer session to another customer account and escalate privileges without requiring administrator access. It was addressed in Adobe Security Bulletin APSB26-92.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Adobe released security updates for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, resolving critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including an unauthenticated customer account takeover (CVE-2026-71362). Successful exploitation could lead to security feature bypass, arbitrary code execution, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Adobe Commerce RCE Vulnerability
items.summary: CVE-2026-48358 is an RCE vulnerability in Adobe Commerce caused by improper encoding, enabling arbitrary code execution without user interaction. This flaw is network-exploitable, requires no authentication, and was addressed in security bulletin APSB26-73.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity vulnerability, part of APSB26-153, is categorized as an Incorrect Authorization (CWE-863) issue. It could lead to privilege escalation.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS) vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity Stored XSS vulnerability (CWE-79) addressed in APSB26-153, which could result in arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS) vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity Stored XSS vulnerability (CWE-79) is part of the APSB26-153 update and could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Improper Input Validation vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity Improper Input Validation (CWE-20) vulnerability included in APSB26-153, which could lead to security feature bypass.

items.title: Cross-site Scripting (Stored XSS) vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity Stored XSS vulnerability (CWE-79) is part of the APSB26-138 update and could result in arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity Incorrect Authorization (CWE-863) vulnerability addressed in APSB26-138, which could lead to privilege escalation.

items.title: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability
items.summary: This high-severity Path Traversal (CWE-22) vulnerability is included in the APSB26-138 update.

items.title: Stored Cross-site Scripting vulnerability
items.summary: A high-severity Stored Cross-site Scripting (CWE-79) vulnerability, part of APSB26-92, that could result in arbitrary code execution. Exploitation requires authentication and administrator privileges.
